findings.origin: Root integration concern, independently reproduced through frozen private entry path in two actual Bun processes with synthetic DB/provider.
findings.summary: Read-only deployment reconciliation refuses legitimate runtime sessions after app startup.
findings.reproduction: Execute with zero runtime sessions persists exact acknowledgement and stops at BUILDING. New process with one runtime session refuses before provider observation; closes DB and performs no mutation.
findings.repair: Separate pre-mutation quiescence from read-only deployment completion; retain exact target/schema/ack/source checks and prohibit all reconciliation mutations.

findings.origin: Root integrated sequence concern, independently reproduced using actual accepted C5 input validator.
findings.summary: Preparation requires a SUCCESS/ready target observation after backup/rehearsal although the reviewed operating sequence stops the app before backup.
findings.reproduction: Baseline positive passes; backup or rehearsal one second after genuine pre-stop target observation refuses; actual REMOVED target also refuses.
findings.repair: Represent authentic pre-stop baseline separately from fresh stopped stage evidence, preserve exact state/identity and deterministic no-replay scope, and keep historical dependency bytes immutable. Never refresh a historical timestamp without a fresh observation.

repaired_prior_findings: F01 acknowledgement required; historical same-commit deployment cannot complete ack-less attempt.
F02 pending observer failures reconcile through fresh process without replay; existing terminal unknown stays blocked.
F03 Execute compares schema22 current state with gate; committed admission reconcile does not demand pre-action state.
F04 acknowledgement must be within attempt/current reconciliation time.
F05 fresh and retained definitive success require exact acknowledgement ID and observation chronology.
limitations: Actual private entry implementation extracted unchanged into injected DB/provider harness; real filesystem create-new/write/sync/close and separate processes exercised. No real database/provider/network/credential action.
Initial process-fixture clock error retained, corrected by shared controlled fixture clock; prior zero-session deployment fixture did not cover app-started sessions.
Prior transport-only reviews remain historical evidence, not proof of executable full workflow.
